description: Recalculate cached formula values directly on original .xlsx bytes using Formualizer without resident sessions. Use when verifying or repairing stale caches or finalizing workbooks written by other tools; use inspect_xlsx/trace_xlsx instead for read-only formula explanation.

options.description: Optional calculation options (profile: 'workbook' | 'strict', requireComplete, calculation, errorLocationLimit, externalLinks, limits).

output_path.description: Optional destination .xlsx path. Omit for read-only check mode.

name: source_recalculate
title: Recalculate XLSX Formula Caches
